facts.text: Walla Walla University owns and operates the Rosario Beach Marine Laboratory on Rosario Beach for marine and experimental science coursework.

sources.title: Rosario Beach Marine Laboratory - Walla Walla University
sources.quote: The Rosario Beach Marine Laboratory, owned and operated by Walla Walla University, exists primarily for the training of undergraduate and graduate students in marine, field, and experimental sciences in a Christian setting.
